rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly: an LRT of ~condition+time+condition:time vs ~condition+time, with time as a 4-level factor, correct reference levels, and per-time-point shrunken Wald contrasts for direction/magnitude. QC (PCA, distances, library size, outlier policy) precedes testing, and a >=10 counts in >=3 samples filter is stated and justified against replicate size. Normalization is handled inside DESeq2 on raw integer counts with size factors, and FDR/shrinkage are explicit (BH, apeglm/ashr, separate families for LRT vs Wald). Enrichment is well justified (ranked GSEA on interaction evidence, ORA with a stated universe, named/versioned collections) though GO BP redundancy and large collection size add some risk of overinterpretation the plan itself flags; the report step is thorough on versions, thresholds, counts, and caveats.
